published_applications.citation: Gaetan Chenevier, The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
published_applications.theorem: Theorem 2.22(ii), pp. 34-35 in the cited version
published_applications.statement_used: A Cayley-Hamilton determinant over a henselian local base with split multiplicity-free residual law gives a generalized matrix algebra with the determinant trace; in rank-one residual blocks its diagonal corners are the base ring.
hypotheses_checked: C is the actual IsCO complete Noetherian local quotient; henselianity is established by the coprime-factor lifting argument.
E is the ordinary full Cayley-Hamilton quotient C[H]/CH(D); PQL7 proves CH(D) lies in the full determinant kernel.
The residual characters are the actual distinct pulled-back characters, hence split multiplicity free with every block of rank one.
Degree is positive, in particular n=4, and ell=3 is allowed.
The theorem's multiplicity-free alternative is used with no finite generation of E, absolute irreducibility, ell>n or n! inversion.

published_applications.statement_used: Faithfully flat maps are surjective on spectra; a flat local map is faithfully flat; flat maps satisfy going down.
hypotheses_checked: PRG18 proves the exact Spo is finite free of positive rank over the original B.
B to Spo is consequently flat and faithful, so a prime exists above the exact original kernel p.
The localized B_p to Spo_P is flat and local; going down lifts both endpoint primes below the single selected P.
All contractions are equalities; no primes over unrelated splitting factors are used.
